reason: Verified diagnosis: 5 of 8 delta>=93 surges lie outside prior-low support; April old-rise ranks 9-34 of 200 and expert itself underpredicts. Compare all-state surge classifiers and a fixed upper quantile, keep normal B prediction separate.
boundary_calibration: Fixed January common positive increase quantiles, verified before fitting; never use future month to estimate boundaries
features: All-state classifiers: verified existing 27 dynamic features. Upper quantile: B 18 features. No new input construction.

classifiers.training: All common past rows; event iff target maximum minus exact previous maximum >=93; no class weights, current production or low-state restriction
classifiers.objective: maximize pooled past-inner non-interpolated AP, tie lower Brier then earlier trial
classifiers.single_class: training positive fraction constant, recorded; no future fallback

upper_quantile.name: Q90_upper
upper_quantile.parameters: Same fixed B HGB settings except loss=quantile and quantile=0.9; no tuning. Predicted quantile is a separate risk output, not substituted for the normal B forecast.
upper_quantile.evaluation: pinball loss, actual coverage, all/peak/surge under-over errors; coverage is measured, never guaranteed

alarms.threshold_choice: Same diagnosis policy: past-inner maximize TP subject to cap; fewer FP then higher threshold as ties. Report realized outer FP, not merely requested cap.

selection.unit: Additional risk channel only; normal point forecast remains B for every row
selection.primary_rank_metric: event-count-weighted mean of monthly AP, since scores from different models/months need not share calibration
selection.eligible: Compared with B_score: weighted monthly AP >=1.05 times baseline; primary-cap pooled TP >=baseline; each month TP >=baseline; primary-cap realized pooled FP fraction<=0.01; require either at least one extra pooled TP or fewer pooled FP. These are exploratory development criteria, not economic optima.
selection.choice: Among eligible largest weighted AP; within 1 percent prefer Logistic_all then HGB_all then Q90_upper. If none pass retain B_score risk baseline and disclose unmet gates. G_HGB_score remains a retrospective comparator, not eligible by this new selection.
selection.secondary_boundary: q90 sensitivity only, no candidate selection on it
selection.not_final: Post-diagnosis development, no claim of independent test or operational savings

stop: One declared all-state and upper-quantile comparison then verify/report; no closed-gate retuning or acceptance relaxation
